question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.constructor_id,
        c.name as constructor_name,
        SUM(res.points) as total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id, c.name
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        constructor_id,
        constructor_name,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points ASC) as rn
    FROM season_points
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT constructor_name, COUNT(*) as season_count
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY constructor_name
)
SELECT constructor_name, season_count
FROM constructor_counts
ORDER BY season_count DESC, constructor_name ASC
LIMIT 5

    SELECT

        res.constructor_id,

),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        constructor_id,
        constructor_name,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points ASC) as rn

)

FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY year", "preview_rows": 50}
